findings.one_line: The selector-distance bound is not reproduced: the normal-link certificate does not make a ray from every deep-tail point reach A_{jC} inside supp(omega_j) with O(t) displacement; for H asymptotic to 1/t, t much smaller than C^{-1} already gives distance asymptotic to C^{-1}, so a level-set/anchor-distance integration lemma is required.

The fallback is asserted negligible for every oracle estimator, but at C=infinity in a critical/irregular class E[H_k^2]=infinity: its positive-probability, independent training-fold Gamma error times the untrimmed evaluation score has infinite second moment; exponential fallback probability cannot repair it.

The L2 risk proof invokes a uniform L2(G^{-1/2}) bound for the cross-fitted Gamma estimator, whereas lem:regular-gamma states only uniform O_P/asymptotic linearity and its claimed fallback comparison; supply that L2 result or derive it here.
